==English== ===Alternative forms=== * {{alter|en|compleat||archaic}} ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*pleh₁-}} {{etymon|en|:inh|enm:compleet|tree=1}} From {{inh|en|enm|compleet|t=full, complete}}, borrowed from {{der|en|fro|complet}} or {{der|en|la|completus}}, past participle of {{m|la|compleō|t=to fill up, to complete}} (whence also {{m|en|complement}}, {{m|en|compliment}}), from {{m|la|com-}} + {{m|la|pleō|t=to fill, to fulfill}} (whence also {{m|en|deplete}}, {{m|en|replete}}, {{m|en|plenty}}), ultimately from {{der|en|ine-pro|*pleh₁-|t=to fill}} ({{cog|en|full}}). ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/kəmˈpliːt/|/kɒmˈpliːt/|a=RP}} * {{IPA|en|/kəmˈpliːt/|a=GA}} * {{audio|en|en-us-complete.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|iːt|s=2}} * {{hyphenation|en|com|plete}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|ambitransitive}} To [[finish]]; to make [[done]]; to reach the [[end]]. #: {{syn|en|accomplish|finish|Thesaurus:end}} #: {{ux|en|He '''completed''' the assignment on time.}} #* {{quote-book|en|url=https://archive.org/details/pictorialhistory02taip/|title=A Pictorial History of the Republic of China: Its Founding and Development|volume=II|year=1981|location=[[Taipei]]|publisher=Modern China Press|OCLC=8883106 |page=416|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/pictorialhistory02taip/page/416/|text=The Tsengwen Reservoir, located at Nanhsi village, Tainan, was '''completed''' in 1973.}} #* {{quote-song|en|year=2023|artist={{w|Better Lovers|Better Lovers}}|title=30 Under 13 |passage=How far are you willing to reach?
While you're coveting outcomes that you can't achieve
Now you're on a mission, but you won't '''complete'''
Shouldn't hold on to me, hold on to me
Try to let go of me, let go of me}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To make [[whole]] or [[entire]]. #: {{syn|en|consummate|perfect|top off}} #: {{ux|en|The last chapter '''completes''' the book nicely.}} # {{lb|en|poker}} To [[call]] from the [[small blind]] in an [[unraised]] [[pot]]. # {{lb|en|informal|mainly|_|sport}} To accomplish every significant achievement within a field. #* {{quote-web|en |title=Novak Djokovic admits he does not feel like he has “'''completed''' tennis” yet |author=Sead Dedovic |date=13 April 2026 |work=Tennis World USA |url=https://www.tennisworldusa.org/tennis/news/Novak_Djokovic/165862/novak-djokovic-admits-he-does-not-feel-like-he-has-completed-tennis-yet/ |passage=["]I went to four Olympic Games, and for a long time that medal was missing. To win in Paris, at 37, representing Serbia, is without question one of the greatest moments of my career. [...]
But I don’t feel like I’ve ‘'''completed'''’ tennis,” concluded the 24-time Grand Slam champion.
The Serbian tennis player hopes to break some more records in his career, although there are very few left.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260819180630/https://www.tennisworldusa.org/tennis/news/Novak_Djokovic/165862/novak-djokovic-admits-he-does-not-feel-like-he-has-completed-tennis-yet/|archivedate=19 August 2026}} #* {{RQ:Guardian|title=The Knowledge; World Cup, Ballon d’Or, Champions League, Euros … has Rodri '''completed''' football? |date=22 July 2026 |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/jul/22/world-cup-champions-league-ballon-dor-euros-has-rodri-completed-football |passage=“Adding the World Cup to his résumé means Rodri has now won the World Cup, the European Championship, the Champions League, and the Ballon d’Or,” writes Owen Bagnall. “Has anyone else ‘'''completed''' football’ like this?”
They have but it’s a small, elite list.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261026002503/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/jul/22/world-cup-champions-league-ballon-dor-euros-has-rodri-completed-football|archivedate=26 October 2026}} ====Usage notes==== * This is a [[catenative]] verb that takes the ''gerund (-ing)''.
